name: Eleusinian Mysteries (cult hub)
dom: mystery initiation; Demeter-Kore cult; agrarian-eschatological soteriology
note: Hub collective for the inner cast of the Eleusinian Mysteries near Athens; abundantly attested epigraphically and in the Homeric Hymn to Demeter (Burkert, Ancient Mystery Cults; Greek Religion).

name: Samothracian Mysteries (cult hub)
dom: mystery initiation; Great Gods/Cabiric cult; protection at sea
note: Hub collective for the cult of the Great Gods (Theoi Megaloi) on Samothrace, paired with the existing Great Gods / Cabeiri entities (Cole, Theoi Megaloi; Burkert, Ancient Mystery Cults).

name: Baubo
dom: ribald jesting; consolation of Demeter; fertility/anasyrma
note: Old woman of Eleusis whose obscene jesting (the iambe/anasyrma motif) makes the grieving Demeter laugh; attested in Orphic fragments and Clement of Alexandria; terracotta Baubo figurines widespread (Burkert, Ancient Mystery Cults).

name: Eumolpus
note: Legendary founding hierophant of Eleusis and eponym of the Eumolpid priestly clan that supplied the hierophants; named in the Homeric Hymn to Demeter and Athenian tradition (Burkert, Greek Religion; Ancient Mystery Cults).

name: Demophoon
dom: infant immortalization rite; nursing by Demeter
note: Infant son of Keleos and Metaneira whom the disguised Demeter nurses and attempts to immortalize in fire at Eleusis; central episode of the Homeric Hymn to Demeter (Burkert, Ancient Mystery Cults).

name: Daeira
note: Minor Eleusinian goddess (the 'Knowing One'), variously identified with Persephone or an Oceanid and given her own priestess and sacrifices at Eleusis; attested in Attic cult and lexicographers (Burkert, Greek Religion).

name: Axieros
note: Named member of the Samothracian tetrad, the Great Goddess identified by ancient sources with Demeter (and the Cybele-type Great Mother); attested in scholia to Apollonius and Samothracian epigraphy (Cole, Theoi Megaloi).

name: Axiokersa
note: Named member of the Samothracian tetrad, identified by the ancient scholia with Persephone; consort of Axiokersos (Cole, Theoi Megaloi; Burkert, Ancient Mystery Cults).

name: Axiokersos
note: Named member of the Samothracian tetrad, identified by ancient sources with Hades (and sometimes Ares); consort of Axiokersa (Cole, Theoi Megaloi).

name: Kadmilos (Kasmilos)
dom: Samothracian servant-god; ithyphallic messenger; Cabiric attendant
note: Fourth member of the Samothracian tetrad, the youthful attendant-god identified by the scholia with Hermes; closely tied to the Cabeiri (Cole, Theoi Megaloi; Burkert, Ancient Mystery Cults).

name: Theos Hypsistos (the Most High God)
dom: pan-Mediterranean monotheizing high-god cult; Hypsistarian worship
note: The 'Most High God' venerated across the Roman East by pagans, God-fearers, and the Hypsistarians; attested in hundreds of dedicatory inscriptions and patristic notices, partly converging with the Jewish God (Yahweh). A cult-title rather than a single named deity (Mitchell; Burkert, Ancient Mystery Cults).
